# Overview

Extends the notebook 62 density panels (CDS length, GC%, GC3%) with a fourth
reporter: the red-emitting click beetle luciferase ("red beetle firefly"
luciferase, CBR). Gene distributions, group definitions, transcript selection,
Wilcoxon tests, and the 6 kb length clip are identical to notebook 62 -- only
the set of reporter reference lines changes.

Two sets of panels are produced:

* all four reporters (Renilla, Firefly, NanoLuc, CBR)
* Firefly + NanoLuc + CBR, matching the reduced panels in notebook 62

CBR is supplied as a bare ORF (1638 nt including its TAA stop, 545 aa). Unlike
the three lab constructs it carries **no** C-terminal ODC PEST degron, so the
PEST spot-check from notebook 62 is deliberately inverted for it. Its translated
N-terminus (MVKREKNVIYGPEPLHPLEDLTAGEMLFRA) is the click beetle luciferase
(*Pyrophorus plagiophthalamus*) N-terminus, which is what the "red beetle"
naming refers to; it is not a *Photinus pyralis* firefly luciferase variant.

As in notebook 62, all CDS metrics -- genes and reporters alike -- are computed
on stop-codon-free ORFs, because GENCODE txdb CDS ranges include the terminal
stop codon.

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)
```

```{r helper_functions}
codon_split <- function(s) {
  n <- nchar(s) %/% 3L
  substring(s,
            seq.int(1L, by = 3L, length.out = n),
            seq.int(3L, by = 3L, length.out = n))
}

# Validate a reporter ORF: in-frame, ATG start, no internal stop, and already
# stop-codon-free (all reporter sequences are stored without their stop codon
# so they match the stop-stripped gene CDS sequences).
STOP_CODONS <- c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")

check_orf <- function(s, name) {
  s   <- toupper(gsub("\\s", "", s))
  cdn <- codon_split(s)
  stopifnot(
    "Reporter ORF length not divisible by 3"     = nchar(s) %% 3 == 0,
    "Reporter ORF does not start with ATG"       = cdn[1] == "ATG",
    "Reporter ORF has an internal stop codon"    =
      !any(cdn[-c(1L, length(cdn))] %in% STOP_CODONS),
    "Reporter ORF still carries a terminal stop" =
      !cdn[length(cdn)] %in% STOP_CODONS
  )
  cat(sprintf("  %-8s OK: %d nt, %d codons\n", name, nchar(s), length(cdn)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

compute_gc3_pct <- function(s) {
  s <- toupper(gsub("\\s", "", s))
  if (is.na(s) || nchar(s) < 3L) return(NA_real_)
  n_codons <- nchar(s) %/% 3L
  starts   <- seq.int(3L, n_codons * 3L, 3L)
  thirds   <- substr(rep.int(s, n_codons), starts, starts)
  sum(thirds %in% c("G", "C")) * 100 / n_codons
}

fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
```

# Load Gene Sets

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
```

# Get Transcript IDs from Feature Matrix

```{r load_feature_matrix}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))

tx_all <- fm %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- tx_all %>%
```

# Hypoxia Fallback for Missing Promoted Genes

```{r select_hypoxia_transcripts}
missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean
]
cat("Promoted genes not in feature matrix:", length(missing_gene_ids), "\n")

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"),
  col_types = "cc"
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(
    transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
    gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)
  )

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples
)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

hyp_tpm <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, TPM) %>%
    mutate(sample = s)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name))

extra_tx_df <- hyp_tpm %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(
    gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids,
    mean_tpm > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
    by = "gene_id_clean"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

n_extra         <- nrow(extra_tx_df)
n_still_missing <- length(missing_gene_ids) - n_extra
cat("Extra transcripts selected from 1hr hypoxia siCTRL:", n_extra, "\n")
cat("Genes with zero hypoxia TPM (still excluded):      ", n_still_missing, "\n")

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes after fallback:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

# Luciferase Reference Sequences

```{r luciferase_sequences}
# NanoLuc -- includes stop codon TAA
nl_seq <- toupper("")
stopifnot("NanoLuc length not divisible by 3" = nchar(nl_seq) %% 3 == 0)
nl_sense <- substr(nl_seq, 1, nchar(nl_seq) - 3)  # strip stop codon for GC3

# Firefly luc2P -- the lab construct, includes stop codon TAA.
# 591 aa = luc2 (550 aa) + the same 41-aa C-terminal PEST extension carried by
# the Renilla and NanoLuc constructs below.
ff_seq <- toupper("")
stopifnot("Firefly length not divisible by 3" = nchar(ff_seq) %% 3 == 0)
ff_sense <- substr(ff_seq, 1, nchar(ff_seq) - 3)  # strip stop codon

# Renilla -- the humanized (codon-optimized) hRluc construct used in the lab,
# as supplied: ATG start retained, no stop codon, 352 codons. See notebook 62
# for why this must not be replaced with an NCBI fetch of the native gene
# (70.8% nt identity, native GC3 25.7% vs humanized 88.4%).
rl_sense <- toupper("")
stopifnot("Renilla construct is not 1056 nt (352 codons)" = nchar(rl_sense) == 1056)

# Red click beetle luciferase (CBR), as supplied: includes the terminal TAA.
# 1638 nt = 545 codons + stop. This is a bare reporter ORF -- no PEST degron,
# no epitope tag -- so it is NOT directly comparable to the three PEST-tagged
# lab constructs above in absolute length; the PEST extension adds 41 codons.
cbr_seq <- toupper("")
stopifnot("CBR length not divisible by 3" = nchar(cbr_seq) %% 3 == 0)
stopifnot("CBR is not 1638 nt (545 codons + stop)" = nchar(cbr_seq) == 1638)
cbr_sense <- substr(cbr_seq, 1, nchar(cbr_seq) - 3)  # strip stop codon

# All reporters are compared on stop-codon-free ORFs, matching the
# stop-stripped gene CDS sequences built in extract_cds_lengths below.
cat("Reporter ORF validation:\n")
check_orf(rl_sense,  "Renilla")
check_orf(ff_sense,  "Firefly")
check_orf(nl_sense,  "NanoLuc")
check_orf(cbr_sense, "CBR")
```

```{r reporter_spot_checks}
# Biological spot-check: the three lab constructs are PEST-destabilized, so each
# must end with the mouse ODC PEST degron. CBR is a bare ORF and must NOT --
# if it ever does, the wrong sequence has been pasted in.
PEST_AA <- "SHGFPPEVEEQAAGTLPMSCAQESGMDRHPAACASARINV"
ends_with_pest <- function(s) {
  aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(s)))
  endsWith(aa, PEST_AA)
}
stopifnot("A PEST-tagged reporter is missing its C-terminal degron" =
  all(vapply(list(rl_sense, ff_sense, nl_sense), ends_with_pest, logical(1))))
stopifnot("CBR unexpectedly carries the ODC PEST degron" =
  !ends_with_pest(cbr_sense))
cat("  Renilla / Firefly / NanoLuc end with the ODC PEST degron; CBR does not\n")

# Biological spot-check: CBR must translate to the click beetle luciferase
# N-terminus (Pyrophorus plagiophthalamus), 545 aa, no internal stop.
cbr_aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(cbr_sense)))
stopifnot("CBR protein is not 545 aa" = nchar(cbr_aa) == 545)
stopifnot("CBR does not encode the click beetle luciferase N-terminus" =
  startsWith(cbr_aa, "MVKREKNVIYGPEPLHPLEDLTAGEMLFRA"))
cat("  CBR translates to 545 aa starting", substr(cbr_aa, 1, 12), "\n")

# Biological spot-check: the Renilla construct must be the humanized version.
stopifnot("Renilla construct does not encode the expected Rluc N-terminus" =
  identical(codon_split(rl_sense)[1:7],
            c("ATG", "GCT", "TCC", "AAG", "GTG", "TAC", "GAC")))  # M A S K V Y D
stopifnot("Renilla GC3 too low -- looks like the native, not humanized, gene" =
  compute_gc3_pct(rl_sense) > 70)
```

```{r luciferase_table}
# Colors: Renilla / Firefly / NanoLuc keep their notebook 62 hues so panels are
# comparable across notebooks -- including NanoLuc's change from Okabe-Ito yellow
# (#F0E442, near-invisible as a thin line on white) to dark blue (#0072B2), made
# in both notebooks together. CBR is red, matching the reporter's emission.
# A true red (#CC0000) rather than Okabe-Ito vermillion (#D55E00) -- vermillion
# sits close enough to the #E69F00 eIF3d-promotes density fill that the line
# reads as part of that group.
luc_df <- tibble(
  reporter   = c("Renilla", "Firefly", "NanoLuc", "CBR (red beetle)"),
  seq        = c(rl_sense, ff_sense, nl_sense, cbr_sense),
  color      = c("#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#0072B2", "#CC0000")
) %>%
  mutate(
    cds_length = nchar(seq),
    gc_pct     = map_dbl(seq, ~ as.numeric(
      letterFrequency(DNAString(.x), letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100),
    gc3_pct    = map_dbl(seq, compute_gc3_pct)
  )

stopifnot("Luciferase GC% out of range" =
  all(luc_df$gc_pct >= 0 & luc_df$gc_pct <= 100))
stopifnot("Luciferase GC3% out of range" =
  all(luc_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & luc_df$gc3_pct <= 100))
stopifnot("Luciferase CDS lengths must be divisible by 3" =
  all(luc_df$cds_length %% 3 == 0))

cat("Luciferase CDS properties (stop codon excluded):\n")
print(luc_df %>% dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct))
```

# Extract CDS Lengths

```{r extract_cds_lengths}
txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
cds  <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)

genome        <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
cds_seqs_full <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, cds)
names(cds_seqs_full) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(cds_seqs_full))
stopifnot("Duplicate transcript IDs after version stripping" =
  !any(duplicated(names(cds_seqs_full))))

# GENCODE txdb CDS ranges INCLUDE the terminal stop codon (e.g. ACTB CDS =
# 1128 nt = 375 aa + stop). Strip it so gene length, GC%, and GC3% are all
# computed on the same stop-free basis as the luciferase reference sequences.
cds_seqs_full <- cds_seqs_full[
  width(cds_seqs_full) >= 3 & width(cds_seqs_full) %% 3 == 0
]

last_codon <- as.character(subseq(cds_seqs_full, start = width(cds_seqs_full) - 2L))
has_stop   <- last_codon %in% c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")
cat("Transcripts with a terminal stop codon in the txdb CDS:",
    sum(has_stop), "of", length(has_stop),
    paste0("(", round(100 * mean(has_stop), 1), "%)\n"))

cds_seqs_nostop <- subseq(cds_seqs_full, start = 1L,
                          end = width(cds_seqs_full) - ifelse(has_stop, 3L, 0L))
cds_seqs_nostop <- cds_seqs_nostop[width(cds_seqs_nostop) > 0]

cds_len_df <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_nostop),
  cds_length          = width(cds_seqs_nostop)
)
stopifnot("Stop-stripped CDS lengths must remain divisible by 3" =
  all(cds_len_df$cds_length %% 3 == 0))

cds_all <- tx_all %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cds_promotes <- tx_promotes %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cds_neg <- tx_neg %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cat("All expressed - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_all), "of", nrow(tx_all), "\n")
cat("Promoted - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_promotes), "of", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
cat("Negative control - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_neg), "of", nrow(tx_neg), "\n")
```

# Extract CDS Sequences, GC, and GC3

```{r extract_gc_gc3}
cds_seq_names <- names(cds_seqs_nostop)

subset_seqs <- function(id_vec) {
  keep <- cds_seq_names %in% id_vec
  s <- cds_seqs_nostop[keep]
  names(s) <- cds_seq_names[keep]
  s
}

cds_seqs_expressed <- subset_seqs(cds_all$transcript_id_clean)
cds_seqs_promotes  <- subset_seqs(cds_promotes$transcript_id_clean)
cds_seqs_neg       <- subset_seqs(cds_neg$transcript_id_clean)

gc_table <- function(s) {
  tibble(
    transcript_id_clean = names(s),
    gc_pct  = as.numeric(letterFrequency(s, letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100,
    gc3_pct = sapply(as.character(s), compute_gc3_pct, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  )
}

gc_all      <- gc_table(cds_seqs_expressed)
gc_promotes <- gc_table(cds_seqs_promotes)
gc_neg      <- gc_table(cds_seqs_neg)

# Biological spot-check: ACTB CDS GC% expected 50-70%
actb_tx <- cds_all %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% pull(transcript_id_clean)
if (length(actb_tx) > 0) {
  actb_gc <- gc_all %>% filter(transcript_id_clean == actb_tx[1]) %>% pull(gc_pct)
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb_gc, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb_gc, 2), "\n")
}

for (nm in c("all", "promotes", "neg")) {
  d <- get(paste0("gc_", nm))
  stopifnot("GC% out of range"  = all(d$gc_pct  >= 0 & d$gc_pct  <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
  stopifnot("GC3% out of range" = all(d$gc3_pct >= 0 & d$gc3_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
}
stopifnot("GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
  between(median(gc_all$gc3_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 40, 65))

# The GC tables and the CDS-length tables must cover the same transcripts.
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (all)" =
  nrow(gc_all) == nrow(cds_all))
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (promotes)" =
  nrow(gc_promotes) == nrow(cds_promotes))
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (neg ctrl)" =
  nrow(gc_neg) == nrow(cds_neg))

cat("GC/GC3 computed - all expressed:", nrow(gc_all), "transcripts\n")
cat("GC/GC3 computed - promoted:     ", nrow(gc_promotes), "transcripts\n")
cat("GC/GC3 computed - neg control:  ", nrow(gc_neg), "transcripts\n")
```

# Where the Reporters Fall in Each Distribution

Percentile of each reporter within the all-expressed and eIF3d-promoted
distributions -- the number behind each reference line in the plots below.

```{r reporter_percentiles}
pctile <- function(x, ref) 100 * mean(ref <= x, na.rm = TRUE)

luc_pct <- luc_df %>%
  dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    len_pct_all = pctile(cds_length, cds_all$cds_length),
    len_pct_pro = pctile(cds_length, cds_promotes$cds_length),
    gc_pct_all  = pctile(gc_pct,  gc_all$gc_pct),
    gc_pct_pro  = pctile(gc_pct,  gc_promotes$gc_pct),
    gc3_pct_all = pctile(gc3_pct, gc_all$gc3_pct),
    gc3_pct_pro = pctile(gc3_pct, gc_promotes$gc3_pct)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with(c("_all", "_pro")), ~ round(.x, 1)))

stopifnot("Percentiles out of range" =
  all(luc_pct %>% dplyr::select(ends_with(c("_all", "_pro"))) %>%
        unlist() %>% between(0, 100)))

print(as.data.frame(luc_pct))

write_csv(luc_pct,
          here("output", "predictive_modeling", "68_luciferase_cds_properties.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/predictive_modeling/68_luciferase_cds_properties.csv\n")
```

# Density Plots with Luciferase Reference Lines

```{r density_setup}
group_cols <- c("All expressed"    = "grey80",
                "Negative control" = "grey40",
                "eIF3d promotes"   = "#E69F00")

# Shared density plotter, carried over from notebook 62. Three things must stay
# consistent across panels:
#   1. show.legend = c(fill = TRUE, colour = FALSE) -- a bare show.legend = FALSE
#      drops the density layer from EVERY legend, including the fill legend, so
#      the three gene groups end up unlabelled while the luciferase lines keep
#      their colour legend.
#   2. per-group n in the legend labels.
#   3. Wilcoxon test, eIF3d promotes vs negative control.
plot_density_luc <- function(df, xvar, luc_var, xlab, title, outfile,
                             xscale = 1, xmax = NULL,
                             reporters = luc_df$reporter) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(.x = .data[[xvar]] / xscale)
  lev <- levels(df$group)

  luc_use <- luc_df %>% filter(reporter %in% reporters)
  stopifnot("No reporters selected for the reference lines" = nrow(luc_use) > 0)
  luc_use <- luc_use %>% mutate(reporter = factor(reporter, levels = reporter))
  luc_cols_use <- setNames(luc_use$color, as.character(luc_use$reporter))

  n_tab  <- df %>% dplyr::count(group)
  labs_v <- setNames(
    sprintf("%s (n = %s)", as.character(n_tab$group), fmt_n(n_tab$n)),
    as.character(n_tab$group)
  )
  df <- df %>% mutate(group_lab = factor(labs_v[as.character(group)],
                                         levels = unname(labs_v[lev])))
  cols_lab <- setNames(unname(group_cols[lev]), unname(labs_v[lev]))

  x_pro <- df$.x[df$group == "eIF3d promotes"]
  x_neg <- df$.x[df$group == "Negative control"]
  wt    <- wilcox.test(x_pro, x_neg)
  wlab  <- sprintf("promotes vs neg ctrl\nWilcoxon p = %s\nn = %s vs %s",
                   format.pval(wt$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 2.2e-16),
                   fmt_n(length(x_pro)), fmt_n(length(x_neg)))

  luc_plot <- luc_use %>% mutate(.x = .data[[luc_var]] / xscale)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .x, fill = group_lab)) +
    geom_density(aes(color = group_lab), alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1,
                 trim = TRUE, show.legend = c(fill = TRUE, colour = FALSE)) +
    geom_vline(data = luc_plot, aes(xintercept = .x, color = reporter),
               linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "solid") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_lab, name = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(cols_lab, luc_cols_use),
                       breaks = names(luc_cols_use), name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wlab,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 4.5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Density", title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(axis.title  = element_text(size = 17),
          axis.text   = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
          plot.title  = element_text(size = 18))

  # coord_cartesian zooms without dropping rows, so the densities are still
  # estimated from the full data -- only the visible x range is clipped.
  if (!is.null(xmax)) {
    n_off <- sum(df$.x > xmax)
    cat(sprintf("%s: x axis clipped at %g; %s of %s transcripts (%.1f%%) fall beyond it\n",
                title, xmax, fmt_n(n_off), fmt_n(nrow(df)),
                100 * n_off / nrow(df)))
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax))
  }

  print(p)
  ggsave(here("plots", outfile), p, width = 9.5, height = 5.5)

  cat(title, "-- Wilcoxon promotes vs neg ctrl: p =",
      format.pval(wt$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r build_plot_frames}
add_group <- function(a, n, p, cols) {
  bind_rows(
    a %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols)) %>% mutate(group = "All expressed"),
    n %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols)) %>% mutate(group = "Negative control"),
    p %>% dplyr::select(all_of(cols)) %>% mutate(group = "eIF3d promotes")
  ) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group,
      levels = c("All expressed", "Negative control", "eIF3d promotes")))
}

len_df <- add_group(cds_all, cds_neg, cds_promotes,
                    c("transcript_id_clean", "cds_length"))
gc_df  <- add_group(gc_all,  gc_neg,  gc_promotes,
                    c("transcript_id_clean", "gc_pct"))
gc3_df <- add_group(gc_all,  gc_neg,  gc_promotes,
                    c("transcript_id_clean", "gc3_pct"))
```

## All four reporters

```{r plot_density_all_reporters, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}

  len_df, "cds_length", "cds_length",

  title   = "CDS length distribution",
  outfile = "68_density_cds_length_all_reporters.pdf",
  xscale  = 1000,
  xmax    = 6
)

  gc_df, "gc_pct", "gc_pct",

)
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
cat("=== Summary ===\n\n")

cat("Gene groups (identical to notebook 62):\n")
cat("  All expressed:    ", fmt_n(nrow(cds_all)), "transcripts\n")
cat("  Negative control: ", fmt_n(nrow(cds_neg)), "transcripts\n")
cat("  eIF3d promotes:   ", fmt_n(nrow(cds_promotes)), "transcripts\n\n")

cat("Reporter CDS properties (stop codon excluded):\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(luc_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-17s %4d bp (%3d codons), GC%% = %.1f, GC3%% = %.1f\n",
              luc_df$reporter[i], luc_df$cds_length[i], luc_df$cds_length[i] / 3,
              luc_df$gc_pct[i], luc_df$gc3_pct[i]))
}
cat("\n")

cat("CBR percentile within each distribution:\n")
cbr_row <- luc_pct %>% filter(reporter == "CBR (red beetle)")
cat(sprintf("  CDS length: %.1f%% of all expressed, %.1f%% of eIF3d promotes\n",
            cbr_row$len_pct_all, cbr_row$len_pct_pro))
cat(sprintf("  CDS GC%%:    %.1f%% of all expressed, %.1f%% of eIF3d promotes\n",
            cbr_row$gc_pct_all, cbr_row$gc_pct_pro))
cat(sprintf("  CDS GC3%%:   %.1f%% of all expressed, %.1f%% of eIF3d promotes\n",
            cbr_row$gc3_pct_all, cbr_row$gc3_pct_pro))
```
